sentences.text: In Re: Abdul Jaidar @ Jaidar Malitha  ...Pet  Mr. Ankan Das.

2. The learned Advocate representing the petitioner strenuously argued that the present petitioner is the brother-in-law of the opposite party No.2, is a migrated labour in Saudi Arabia and is not resident of that locality and has been falsely implicated.
Charge-sheet has been submitted under Sections 498A/34 of the IPC and prima facie no documents have been assessed by the investigating officer as alleged in the written complaint.

That apart the complaint lodged under Section 156(3)
after a considerable delay which is not explained.
3. Hence, an arguable case has been made out before this Court for which the matter is required to be heard.
4. In view of the above, the instant revisional application is admitted.
5. The petitioner is directed to serve notice upon the opposite party.
6. The matter to appear as contested application four weeks hence before the regular bench.

7. Let there be stay all further proceedings pending before the learned Magistrate till 30th April,
2026 or until further order whichever is earlier.
8.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Chaitali Chatterjee (Das), J.)
